name: captcha-pause
description: The real gap named in CLEAR-GLASS-CAPABILITY-BREAKDOWN-2026-08-23.md: 'CLI drives automation, but pop a real UI prompt when a CAPTCHA blocks it, then resume.' Composes the already-real dom.query gate (detection) with a new, real 'block until human clears it' poll loop, surfaced via the already-real toast driver.exec action — not a passive detector, a pause-and-wait primitive.
author: James Brooks (Erosmancer)
